title: Sparse polynomial threshold representation
statement: Let $n>0$ and let $f:\\{−1,1\\}^n\\to\\{−1,1\\}$. There is a real-valued function $p$ on the cube whose threshold signs equal $f$ at every input, and whose Fourier support has size at most $\\left\\lceil4n\\left(\\sum_{S\\subseteq[n]}|\\widehat{f}(S)|\\right)^2\\right\\rceil$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
